Tutorial: ^To complete this puzzle you need to assign data types correctly.
^Integers are for whole numbers such as 5 or 7 meanwhile Floats are for decimal numbers with suffix "f" such as 7.6f or 9.45f
^Bools and Strings are simple too actually. Bools can have only 2 values. TRUE & FALSE.
^And strings can be any list of characters surrounded by quote (<color=#F8FF30>"</color>) characters.
^All you need to do is match the correct data types correctly.
